triples.tail_surface: All bolts on base plate / base frame shall be tightened with recommended torques
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 按推荐扭矩拧紧底座/底架所有螺栓
triples.evidence_text: All bolts on base plate / base frame shall be tightened with recommended torques.

triples.tail_surface: foundation should be made from proper steel plate or profile steel with enough stiffness to support pump to run stably
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 基础应采用具有足够刚度的合适钢板或型钢制成以支撑泵稳定运行
triples.evidence_text: For Marine & Offshore installation, foundation should be made from proper steel plate or profile steel with enough stiffness to support pump to run stably and reduce potential vibrations.

triples.tail_surface: Pipes shall be connected correctly and not overloading the pump flanges
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 管道应正确连接且不对泵法兰施加过载
triples.evidence_text: Pipes shall be connected correctly and not overloading the pump flanges.

triples.tail_surface: All the edges of pump foot have full contact with the supporting brackets
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵脚所有边缘与支撑支架完全接触
triples.evidence_text: All the edges of pump foot have full contact with the supporting brackets.
